fields.title: 📖 True Zuhd Is to Leave What Does Not Benefit the Ākhirah
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Taymiyyah** said:

> ***“Ibn Taymiyyah said in substance: Zuhd is to leave what does not benefit in the Ākhirah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Zuhd does not mean throwing away everything worldly, but freeing the heart and one’s time from what brings no benefit before Allah.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Taymiyyah, Majmūʿ al-Fatāwā; Definition von Zuhd: Tark mā lā yanfaʿ fī al-Ākhirah.
